## Open findings

### High (4)

- `admin-users-add-blank-id-silent-noop` — **AdminUsersSection** — Submitting the add form with a blank ID is a silent no-op
- `admin-users-load-failure-renders-live-controls` — **AdminUsersSection** — A load failure leaves every control live and the list reading as empty — `client/settings/sections/admin/AdminUsersSection.svelte:159`
- `admin-users-loading-reads-as-empty` — **AdminUsersSection** — Loading claims there are no users
- `admin-users-open-access-toggle-acts-on-unloaded-state` — **AdminUsersSection** — The open-access toggle acts on a value it has not loaded yet

### Med (10)

- `admin-users-add-not-guarded-against-double-submit` — **AdminUsersSection** — Add user can be fired twice
- `admin-users-block-vs-remove-unexplained` — **AdminUsersSection** — Nothing states how Block differs from Remove
- `admin-users-blocked-row-unmarked` — **AdminUsersSection** — A blocked user's row looks identical to an active one
- `admin-users-hand-rolled-badges` — **AdminUsersSection** — Two hand-rolled badge classes stand in for `Pill`
- `admin-users-raw-source-values` — **AdminUsersSection** — The Source column shows a raw storage value
- `admin-users-remove-confirm-names-raw-id` — **AdminUsersSection** — The remove confirmation names an id, not a person
- `admin-users-status-not-announced` — **AdminUsersSection** — Status and error lines announce nothing
- `admin-users-table-not-sortable-or-width-pinned` — **AdminUsersSection** — The users table is neither sortable nor width-pinned
- `plugins-inactive-copy-overclaims-approval` — **PluginsSection** — The ineligible-plugin sentence names approval as the remedy for six different states — `client/settings/lib/plugin-eligibility.ts:44`
- `transcript-aria-live-history-race` — **TranscriptApp** — The history bulk-load can be announced as if it were live

### Low (7)

- `admin-users-empty-copy-dead-end` — **AdminUsersSection** — The empty table is a dead end, and says the same thing when a search misses — `client/settings/sections/admin/AdminUsersSection.svelte:243`
- `admin-users-open-access-card-offscale` — **AdminUsersSection** — The open-access card's geometry is off the token scale
- `admin-users-pending-id-hidden` — **AdminUsersSection** — A pending user has no readable identifier
- `admin-users-refresh-busy-not-announced` — **AdminUsersSection** — The refresh control's busy state is silent — `client/shared/ui/Btn.svelte:53`
- `admin-users-username-truncates-silently` — **AdminUsersSection** — A long username truncates with no way to read it — `client/settings/components/IdCell.svelte:20`
- `settings-app-focus-ring-scoped-to-grid` — **SettingsApp** — The focus ring's colour is a hardcoded literal instead of the accent token — `client/shared/tokens.css:39`
- `settings-app-jump-menu-ignores-collapse` — **SettingsApp** — Re-picking the jump menu's current section does nothing

## Deferred

- `repos-no-edit-capability` — **ReposSection** — A repository can only be added or deleted, never edited
- `settings-app-no-shared-type-scale` — **SettingsApp** — No shared type scale, so every component invents its own font sizes
